purpose: Construct a portable, independently certifiable scientific decision instrument; freeze its generic capability, then build and evaluate a different successor objective.
construction_route: Included frontier assistant and delegated agents, not an execution of the local-model discovery engine in PR520.

first_outcome.input: Doyle laboratory amidation complete matrix: 96 condition combinations by 10 nucleophiles
first_outcome.objective: Smallest portfolio of recorded conditions attaining at least the selected fraction of each substrate's best recorded yield.
first_outcome.acceptance: Every substrate covered, exact source-linked feasible assignment, independently checked global minimum cardinality over the recorded finite matrix.
first_outcome.validation: Independent 1024-state coverage DP, HiGHS MILP, and proof replay; competent greedy is an additional baseline.
first_outcome.input_policy: Exact decimal arithmetic, no clipping, no missing cells or duplicates, full recipe identifiers. Nonpositive substrate maximum requires abstention.

retained_asset: Generic pure-Python minimum-cover constructor with a feasible witness and an independently replayable proof of infeasibility at one fewer option.

successor.anticipated_family: A different diagnostic/challenge-panel objective over recorded reaction responses; exact cases and thresholds are independently frozen before evaluation.
successor.exposure_rule: Freeze first solver source and first result before second builder receives detailed successor contract. Planned structural transfer, not an unforeseen application.
arms: Frozen retained instrument plus new adapter
Equal-content ordinary reuse of the identical first instrument
successor.primary_measure: Same independently accepted distinct outcome, complete computational preparation, solving and verification resources; all cases retained.
successor.interpretation: A tie with ordinary reuse establishes reusable engineering, not an improved invention procedure. No-retained controls may use strong libraries and construct their own solution.

unknown: Beneficiary adoption and willingness to pay
costs.financial_actions: None. No revenue, simulated sale, or spending account created.

source_selection.chosen_because: Real complete primary measurements, decisive exact computational acceptance, portable useful outputs, distinct successor decision possible without physical infrastructure.
